procedure: per-subject maximum-likelihood fit on observed choice sequences; 8 random starts, L-BFGS-B; BIC = k*ln(n) + 2*nll
extension_note: M5 is the published winning model for this task (alpha+, alpha-, beta, perseverance, with counterfactual updating of the unchosen option at tied rates). M6 isolates counterfactual updating. Neither was in the registered set; both are reported as an unregistered extension.
